title: Glowing hourglass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='sand' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ffb300'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='glass' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#bff9ff' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#4fd0e0' stop-opacity='0.5'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- top cap -->
  <rect x='24' y='10' width='52' height='9' rx='4' fill='#c98b3a'/>
  <rect x='24' y='10' width='52' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e8b060'/>

  <!-- bottom cap -->
  <rect x='24' y='81' width='52' height='9' rx='4' fill='#c98b3a'/>
  <rect x='24' y='86' width='52' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e8b060'/>

  <!-- glass body -->
  <path d='M30 19 C30 34 48 42 48 50 C48 58 30 66 30 81 L70 81 C70 66 52 58 52 50 C52 42 70 34 70 19 Z'
        fill='url(#glass)' stroke='#9ff0fa' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- sand in top chamber -->
  <path d='M36 24 C36 33 47 40 49 47 L51 47 C53 40 64 33 64 24 Z' fill='url(#sand)'/>

  <!-- falling stream -->
  <rect x='48.6' y='47' width='2.8' height='22' fill='#ffd24d'/>

  <!-- sand pile bottom -->
  <path d='M34 81 C34 72 44 68 50 68 C56 68 66 72 66 81 Z' fill='url(#sand)'/>
  <path d='M44 81 C44 76 47 73 50 73 C53 73 56 76 56 81 Z' fill='#fff0a8'/>

  <!-- glass shine -->
  <path d='M36 26 C36 36 45 43 46 49' stroke='#eaffff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- glow accents -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='1.6' fill='#fffbe0'/>
</svg>
